mainEntity.name: What were the Phoenix Lights of 1997?

acceptedAnswer.text: On March 13, 1997, thousands of people across Arizona and Nevada reported a massive V-shaped craft silently gliding across the night sky. The object was reportedly miles wide.

mainEntity.name: Did the governor of Arizona see the Phoenix Lights?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Arizona Governor Fife Symington was among the witnesses. He later said: "I witnessed a massive delta-shaped craft silently moving over the mountains."

mainEntity.name: Was the Phoenix Lights ever explained?

acceptedAnswer.text: The US Air Force claimed they were flares dropped during a training exercise, but witnesses and researchers dispute this, noting the flares didn't match the formation or behavior of the reported craft.
